review: I recently attended Alan Ranger’s photography workshop in Padley Gorge and Bolehill quarry, and it was an excellent experience from start to finish. Alan is incredibly friendly and approachable, creating a comfortable learning environment for photographers of all skill levels. One aspect I particularly appreciated was the individual attention he gave to every participant. Rather than following a one-size-fits-all approach, he provided customised guidance based on each person's experience level, helping everyone get the most out of the workshop. The workshop was very well organised and ran exactly to schedule, which reflected Alan’s professionalism and respect for participants' time. The outdoor shooting locations were carefully chosen and offered perfect opportunities to practise different photography techniques in real-world conditions. What stood out most was learning to see photography from a completely different perspective. Alan’s vast experience and deep knowledge of the craft were evident throughout the day, and the insights he shared went far beyond camera settings and technical aspects. Overall, this workshop was absolutely worth the money. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced photographer looking to refine your skills, Alan’s rich experience, practical teaching style, and personalised approach make this workshop highly recommended.  Thank you Alan!
